Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
Just one more Gargoyle question, I think..

Dawn Op: all damage in the "resulting combat" will be aggravated.

Does it still count as the "resulting combat" if a slave is
fighting in place of someone of the master clan?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


No. Slave rule: "cancel the combat". [BL 3.9]

Messages.Author: Reyda
Messages.Body:
"Jozxyqk" <jfeu...@eecs.tufts.edu> wrote in message
news:QzoS7.16615$5W5.7...@typhoon.ne.mediaone.net...


no. when you use the slave "bodyguard" clause, you *cancel* the action and
untap the (!)tremere preforming it. Then the gargoyle slave enters combat
with the minion. the combat is not resulting from the action successfuly
blocked, it's another, different effect. so your dawn operation does not
trigger.

reyda
